is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles culicifacies, a major malaria vector in India (Page 2).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for Vgsc L995F (L1014F) and Vgsc L995S (L1014S) (Page 4, 6, 7).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 2 (Page 7) provides genotype counts (L/L, L/F, F/F, L/S, S/S, F/S) and allele frequencies for An. culicifacies.

african_field_population.evidence: The study was conducted in Keshkal sub-district, Chhattisgarh State, India. The criteria requires an AFRICAN country.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical field study conducted by the authors (Page 2).

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted in 16 clusters of CHC Keshkal, district Kondagaon, Chhattisgarh State, India (Page 2, 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study covers surveys in 2014 and 2015 (Page 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study is a specific field investigation in 16 clusters of a larger 80-cluster project.

supplement.evidence: The required genotype data is provided in Table 2 of the main text.

assessment.summary: This study monitored deltamethrin resistance in Anopheles culicifacies in 16 clusters in Chhattisgarh, India, following LLIN distribution. It assessed susceptibility, synergist effects, and kdr (L1014F/S) genotype frequencies in live and dead mosquitoes.
